title: 阿兹尔·日轮石廊
description: 金色鸟首阿兹尔在无人的太阳石廊静持权杖，红色长袍垂地，强光把冠饰和肩甲切成鲜明形面。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Azir is a regal avian ascended emperor with a long golden beak, tall narrow crown, bright eyes, and layered gold armor over deep red cloth. Preserve his bird head, dignified upright torso, and fully covered limbs beneath an opaque full-length robe and boots. His long imperial staff is planted vertically at his side as a ceremonial support, without commanding soldiers or attacking.
art_direction.scene: Frame him beneath a colossal circular opening in a sandstone colonnade, standing still with one hand resting around the grounded staff. The red robe forms a decisive vertical block. A hard beam of late sun crosses the armor and floor, described through broad coarse wax marks; empty receding arches and a thin desert horizon provide grandeur without a crowd.
art_direction.palette: sun gold, oxblood red, sandstone, indigo shadow
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
